evidenceRule: Observed cadence is a sample-window observation, not a claim about every social account.

peers.name: Mondi
peers.observedPattern: Frequent short insights, case studies and press releases connect an application problem with measured outcomes, machinery collaboration or regulatory context.
peers.lesson: Use evidence-led application stories and state validation boundaries.
peers.doNotCopy: Claims, customer names, test results and branded campaign language.

peers.name: CarePac
peers.observedPattern: The sampled blog archive published multiple buyer-intent articles per week around pouch formats, volume, configuration and cost decisions.
peers.lesson: Build dense purchasing-question clusters and repurpose each article into visual checklists and short posts.
peers.doNotCopy: Article wording, branded examples, unsupported volume or cost claims.

peers.name: Amcor
peers.observedPattern: Product announcements are framed around a concrete brand or operational outcome and supported by named product families.
peers.lesson: Lead with the buyer outcome, then explain the packaging decision and supporting evidence.
peers.doNotCopy: Product names, customer relationships and performance claims.

experiments.name: evidence-carousel
experiments.measure: qualified impressions and saves after 28 days

experiments.name: buyer-checklist
experiments.measure: indexed pages, referral sessions and branded searches after 28 days
